Crew morale chart (average and minimum lines, one axis 0-100) sits under the roster.

### 13.8 Permits & compliance

**Purpose:** show what each claim may legally do now, what is in the pipe and when it is likely to land, what keeping it costs, and how close the operation is to a limit. P2 builds the U.S. federal regime with its two state overlays (the northern district lies in Alaska, the arid district in Nevada); P6 adds Alaska state land and Yukon. All dice are hidden: review durations and stage outcomes are shown only as §6 `stageForecast` ranges (§6 keys application dice by stage, so waiting never re-rolls them).

**Agencies and the disclaimer** (owner ruling 2026-10-05, D-13.67). The districts are fictional; the agencies are the real bodies of the jurisdiction each district sits in (§6 6.1 agency map). Every agency name on these screens, in the inbox and in Help comes from §6 `agencyFor(state, claimId, key)`: the abbreviation in table cells and chips (`BLM`, `DEC`, `NDEP`, `MSHA`, `USACE`), the full name on hover and at the first mention in a message. No screen hard-codes an agency or shows a seal, logo, letterhead, official's name or form number. The foot of every Permits & compliance tab carries §6's one-line disclaimer (text key `permits.disclaimer`): *Rules in this game are simplified game mechanics, not legal or regulatory advice.* The same line heads the Help glossary and appears on the setup wizard's World step (13.14). The Help glossary's **Agencies** section lists each body with its job in the game and the rule the game simplifies (§6 `AgencySpec.roleKey`, e.g. `BLM: surface management under 43 CFR 3809, simplified`), and names EPA in its oversight role.

| Tab | Content |
|---|---|
| Authority | Per held claim: §6 `operatingAuthority` chip (none / casual / notice / plan) with `authorityDetail`; an ancillary approvals checklist (water right, discharge, stream/wetlands, state reclamation, MSHA mine ID and crew training, business license, required insurance), each with status, the approving agency from `agencyFor` (in the northern district: DNR water rights, DEC's APDES placer permit, USACE Alaska District, DNR reclamation; in the arid district: NDWR, NDEP, USACE Sacramento District, NDEP BMRR), what it gates, and a link (required insurance in P2–P3 reads §11 `insuredStatus`: the GL stub binds automatically, with an `insurance.bound` inbox note, the first week plan-tier coverage is needed, so the row shows `Bound automatically · $8,000/yr` and needs no action; the Bank > Insurance tab arrives in P4); an activity matrix from `activityAllowed` (sampling pits, trench, bulk sample, mechanized mining, in-stream work) × claims. Primary action: `Start application`. |
| Pipeline | Kanban with columns in §6 `PipelineStage` order: preparing → completeness → publicComment → validityExam (only on plans touching a withdrawn overlay) → technicalReview → infoRequested → decision → approved / denied / withdrawn, with appeal as a side lane (P6 adds the consolidated `intake`/`subReview` lanes and the Yukon `adequacy` … `licenceDecision` lanes). Card: application type, claims, preparer, weeks in stage, remaining weeks P10–P90 per stage, cost to date, next action (`Respond to info request by Wk 31`). Cards are not draggable, because stage changes belong to the regulator (D-13.40); actions are buttons: submit when preparation is complete (`permits/submitApplication`), respond (`permits/respondInfoRequest`), withdraw, appeal (4-week window). |
| Permits & conditions | Permit table: permit, type, claims, issued, expiry, renewal due, transferability on sale (§6 6.12), status. **Condition meters** from §6 `conditionUsage()` as bullet bars (`Disturbed 4.2 / 5.0 ac`, `Water 610 / 700 gpm`, `In-stream window closes Wk 26`), warning chip at `ui.condMeterWarnFrac` (90%) of a limit. **Compliance mode** per claim (`permits/setComplianceMode`): exceeding a condition is a deliberate choice behind a confirmation that lists the detection, fine and standing consequences; trade-off `More output now vs detection, fines and standing`. Actions: renew, amend (`Bigger cap vs review risk`). |
| Bonds | Bond table: bond, instrument (cash / surety / LOC from P4 / pool in P6), status (§6 `Bond.status`: pending / active / **cancel notice** with `Cancels Wk N` from `cancelEffectiveTurn` and a link to the `bondReplacement` obligation / released / forfeited / replaced), face, required (reclamation cost estimate), shortfall, **pending increase** (`+2.0 ac, face $57,200 from Wk 31`, from `pendingIncrease`), collateral in `cash.restricted`, annual premium, permits covered, release status. Actions: surety quote (`permits/requestSuretyQuote`), post, adjust, replace instrument, request release. A panel shows reclamation liability by claim (open acres by feature, RCE, ARO). Trade-off: `Cash bond ties up cash; surety costs a premium and collateral`. |
| Inspections | Log: week, agency (`agencyFor` abbreviation, full name on hover), claim, type (routine / complaint / follow-up), result, citations (S&S flag), fine, abatement due, orders (stop-work, withdrawal), contest status. Actions: abate (`permits/abateViolation`, auto-abate toggle), contest (`permits/contestViolation`: `Legal fee vs lower fine and a clean record`), pay fine. |
| Standing | Gauge for `company.regulatorStanding` (0-100) with its explain tree (deltas and reasons, last 104 weeks) and an effects table from §6 (inspection-rate multiplier `0.5 + (1 − S/100)`, review time, approvals and bonding effects). |
| Obligations | The calendar agenda filtered to compliance categories (land, permit, bond, safety, water, reclamation, enforcement). Panels: small miner's waiver intent (`permits/setWaiverIntent`: `$200/unit vs work + forfeiture risk`), assessment-work credit vs required, auto-pay per category (`permits/setAutoPay`), auto-file status: the permitting specialist's, or the owner toggle `permits/setAutoFile { owner }` (P2; trade-off `Owner desk days and the owner's defect odds vs clicks`), and batch buttons `Pay all due this week` / `File all due this week` (`permits/payObligations` P1, `permits/fileObligations` P2). |

**Application stepper** (`permits/startApplication`). (1) Type and claims (notice, plan of operations, ancillary types). (2) Scope: acres, water gpm, season window, in-stream work, with a complexity hint. (3) Preparer: owner / specialist / consultant tier, each showing prep cost (USD), desk weeks and quality; rush (desk weeks × 0.65 at higher cost); pre-application meeting (+2 weeks, $1,500). (4) Estimates: prep cost, baseline field weeks (operating weeks only), total weeks to decision P10–P90 from `stageForecast`, and the bond estimate. Trade-off: `Quality vs cost vs speed`. (5) Review & start. A stop-work order that idles a whole plan arrives as a blocking decision (§6) and links here and to Operations.

### 13.9 Advance Week and Run to Next Decision

**Advance Week.** Calls `advanceWeek(state, { explain: true })` synchronously on the main thread (13.18). Before it runs, a **pre-advance sheet** appears only if at least one of these holds (D-13.21):
```
defaultsThisWeek = non-blocking PendingDecisions with deadlineTurn == turn                 // will auto-default this week
f                = select.forecast13Week(state)                                            // §11 11.19.6 (P1–P3: one series)
need1            = f.outflows[1] − f.inflowsSched[1]                                       [USD]
autoGold1        = no §10 standing sale order ? 0
                 : f.inflowsProd.P10[1]                                    // this week's cleanup lots, sold in step 12 before payroll
                   + (order = keepCashAbove ? goldOnHandLocalNet : 0)      // held lots the order would also sell (§10 quote)   [USD]
fund1            = cashOnHand + autoGold1 + (sweep.autoDrawRevolver ? revolverAvailability : 0)   [USD]  (card-routed bills use card credit first)
shortfall        = need1 − fund1
firstShort       = first category in finance.paymentPriority not fully covered when fund1 is applied in order (§11 11.4)
show sheet if defaultsThisWeek.length > 0 or shortfall > 0
```
Gold counts toward this week's funding only when a standing order will actually sell it in step 12 (§2.6: cleanup and standing orders run before finance), and at the P10 cleanup figure, so a cleanup week with an order does not raise a false shortfall and a week without one still does (D-13.48).
The sheet lists each auto-default and its default option. If there is a shortfall it shows the amount, the first category that would go short with §11's consequence (`Payroll short by $6,240 → missed payroll (distress stage 3)`), the local-buyer net for the gold on hand (§10 quote), and shortcuts (Sell gold, Set a standing sale order, Draw revolver (P4), Delay purchase). It never blocks: `Advance anyway` is always available. Settings can turn the sheet off. During a reorganization case (P4) the forecast already leaves stayed pre-filing bills out of `outflows` (§11 11.16.2), adequate-protection bills and plan installments are `debt.secured` outflows, and a shortfall that reaches one names the case consequence: `Plan installment short by $4,180 → missed plan payment (one more converts the case to liquidation)` or `Adequate protection to Northline unpaid → the stay lifts for its collateral at the next month end`.

After the week: the report is stored, the dashboard **Last week** panel updates, a polite live-region announcement summarises the week (`Week 29 complete: cash −$46,900; 1 cleanup, 52.901 raw oz weighed; 1 new alert`), critical toasts fire, baselines are captured if due, and autosave runs (13.16).

**Run to Next Decision.** The split button's menu holds:
- **Max weeks**: 4 / 8 / 13 / 26 (default, `ui.runMaxWeeksDefault`) / 52.
- **Stop rules** (persisted per save in `UiPersisted.stopRules`):

| Rule | Default | Editable | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Blocking decision created | on | no | §2.7 |
| Critical alert | on | no | includes a muted warning kind that escalates to critical |
| Warning alert | on | per-kind mute (P2) | §2.7; muted kinds still go to the inbox |
| Season phase change in a district with held ground | on | yes | breakup, freeze-up |
| Deadline within N weeks | on, N = `ui.runDeadlineNoticeWeeks` (2) | N = 1-8 (P2) | obligations that need a player action, offer, inspection and decision deadlines, auction closes, a reorganization plan or amendment due (P4); fires once per item (obligations once per (category, due week) group), on the week it enters the window; self-settling obligations never fire it (D-13.46) |
| Every cleanup | off | per claim | any plant line's cleanup on the claim; one stop per claim and week, however many lines cleaned up |
| Cash below $X | off | X | fires on the downward crossing only |
| Any machine failure | off (critical failures always stop) | | P3 |
| New listing matches a saved search | off | per search | P2 |
| Start of each month | off | | P2; weeks after §1 `monthEndWeeks` |
| Specific week | off | week picker | P2 |
| Gold moves ±X% from the run's start | off, X = `ui.runGoldMoveStopPct` (5%) | X | P5; uses `RunAnchor.startSpotUsdPerFineOz` |

**Default rules** (D-13.69). The engine's `defaultStopRules(params?: StopRuleParams)` builds the defaults in this table. The engine may not import `ui.*` configuration (it sits outside `TuningResolved`, §2.10), so the deadline notice and the gold-move threshold are parameters, `{ deadlineNoticeWeeks, goldMoveStopPct }`, that default to the engine's `STOP_RULE_DEFAULTS` (2, 0.05). The UI passes `ui.runDeadlineNoticeWeeks` and `ui.runGoldMoveStopPct`; the simulator uses the defaults; a UI test (`src/ui/stopRuleDefaults.test.ts`) keeps the defaults equal to the `ui.*` values.

**While running.** A progress strip replaces the top bar's action area: `Running - Wk 3 of up to 26 - cash $254,200 [Stop]` with a live mini-sparkline of cash. `Esc` or Stop cancels. Cancelling keeps the state after the last completed week (D-13.2). Screens stay readable but every mutating control is disabled while a run is active.

**Run summary** (a drawer that opens when the run stops): header with weeks covered, date range and **stop reasons** (each linked to its message, decision or entity); totals (Δcash, bcy washed, raw oz weighed, fine oz sold, payments made, obligations met, messages created, e.g. `14: 3 warnings, 0 critical`); a per-week table (week, cash end, Δcash, bcy washed, raw oz weighed, notable items linked to messages); a cash line chart across the skipped weeks; and `Open these messages` (inbox filtered to messages created in turns `startTurn + 1 … endTurn`, D-13.35).

Example: mid-season, cash $210,400 at the start of Wk 28 on the §7 7.8 claim (3,264 bcy/wk, $44,379/wk of direct cost from §7 7.11.1, plus about $1,900/wk of overhead), with the "every cleanup" rule on for the claim and no sale order beyond the default `keepCashAbove $0`.

| Week | Cash end | Δ cash | bcy washed | Raw oz weighed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wk 28 | $164,100 | −$46,300 | 3,264 | — | |
| Wk 29 | $117,200 | −$46,900 | 3,113 | 52.901 | Cleanup #4 (rule; on the off-day, so crew overtime): 6.348 raw oz lease royalty in kind, lot of 46.553 raw oz held |

Wk 29 washes 3,113 bcy because the 150-bcy pad that started Wk 28 is used up, so the plant washes about what the truck hauls (3,114 bcy); the two weeks total §7 7.10's 6,377 bcy. Stop reason: `Cleanup on Upper Caribou #2 (rule)`. No cash warning fires: the 13-week line (incl. planned cleanups, P50) counts the Wk 31 cleanup at about $127k of local-buyer net, so it stays above $0. On scheduled outflows alone it would dip below $0 in Wk 32, after the month-end loan payment in Wk 31: the P1–P3 false alarm the production line removes (D-13.48). The player sells the new lot from the summary's `Sell gold` link (≈ $143k at the local buyer: 46.553 raw × est. 0.84 × $4,200 = $164.2k, less the 10% discount and the buyer's haircut of about 3%) or holds it.

```ts
type StopRule =
  | { kind: 'warningKinds'; muted: AlertKind[] }
  | { kind: 'seasonPhase'; scope: 'held' | 'all'; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'deadlineWithin'; weeks: number; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'everyCleanup'; claimIds: ClaimId[] | 'all'; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'goldMove'; pct: number; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'cashBelow'; cents: Cents; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'machineFailure'; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'listingMatch'; searches: { id: string; filter: ListingFilter }[]; enabled: boolean }  // filters travel with the rule
  | { kind: 'monthStart'; enabled: boolean }
  | { kind: 'atTurn'; turn: number };
interface RunAnchor { runId: string; startTurn: number; startSpotUsdPerFineOz: number; startCashCents: Cents }  // UI-only
type StopReason = { kind: 'blockingDecision' | 'alert' | 'seasonPhase' | 'rule' | 'maxWeeks' | 'gameOver';
                    rule?: StopRule['kind']; ref?: MsgId | DecId | EntityRef; label: string; severity?: Severity };
interface RunSummary { runId: string; startTurn: number; endTurn: number; stoppedBecause: StopReason[];
  rows: { turn: number; cashEndCents: Cents; cashDeltaCents: Cents; payWashedBcy: number;
          weighedRawOz: number; soldFineOz: number; msgIds: MsgId[] }[];
  totals: { cashDeltaCents: Cents; payWashedBcy: number; weighedRawOz: number; soldFineOz: number;
            paymentsCents: Cents; messages: Record<Severity, number> } }
```

Stop rules are evaluated by a pure engine function, so the simulator, tests and the UI worker all stop identically (Needs from §2):
```
evaluateStops(prev: GameState, week: WeekResult, rules: StopRule[], anchor: RunAnchor): StopReason[]
  s = week.state; t = s.clock.turn; R = []
  each PendingDecision created this turn with blocking                         → blockingDecision
  each message m in week.report.stopCandidates (13.10):
      severity ∈ {critical, blocking}                                        → alert
      severity = warning and m.kind ∉ warningKinds.muted                      → alert
  seasonPhase:    district d with phase(prev, d) ≠ phase(s, d), and scope = 'all' or the player holds ground in d
  deadlineWithin: item i in upcomingDeadlines(s) with (i.dueTurn − t ≤ N) and (i.dueTurn − (t − 1) > N or i.createdTurn = t)
  everyCleanup:   claim c in claimIds with week.report.ops[c].cleanups non-empty            // one reason per claim, label names the lines
  goldMove:       |spot(s) / anchor.startSpotUsdPerFineOz − 1| ≥ pct
  cashBelow:      cashOnHand(prev) ≥ X and cashOnHand(s) < X
  machineFailure: any 'machine.failure' signal this turn, any severity
  listingMatch:   any listing with createdTurn = t matching any rule filter
  monthStart:     week(s) = 1 or week(s) − 1 ∈ §1 monthEndWeeks          // weeks 1, 6, 10, 14, 19, 23, 27, 32, 36, 40, 45, 49
  atTurn:         t = turn
  gameOver:       s.company.runStatus ≠ 'active'                                   // a reorganization case leaves it 'active'; label from
                                                                                  // §1 endReason and liquidationPath ('Liquidated: case converted, 2 missed plan payments')
  (caller adds maxWeeks when t − anchor.startTurn ≥ maxWeeks)
  return R deduplicated by ref, ordered: blockingDecision, gameOver, alert (critical, then warning), seasonPhase, rule
upcomingDeadlines(s) = open §6 Obligations that need a player action (needsAction below), one item per (category, dueTurn) group
                       ∪ §5 negotiation, inspection and auction deadlines ∪ §9 equipment auction closes ∪ non-blocking PendingDecision deadlines
                       ∪ §11 reorganization case deadlines that need the player: the plan due turn and an amendment deadline (P4)
                       // plan installments and adequate-protection bills are billable payments §11 settles, so they never fire it
needsAction(o)       = o.filing ? not autoFiled(o)                                  // a form someone must file
                                 : settlementClass(o) = 'statutory' and not o.autoPay // a payment only the player or auto-pay makes
                       // §6 6.9: billable payments are settled by §11 in their due week; autoFiled = a routine form while a
                       // permitting specialist is employed or the owner's permits/setAutoFile toggle is on
```

### 13.10 Alerts taxonomy and notification rules

**Severity semantics.**

| Severity | Where it shows | Stops runs | Toast | Mutable | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| info | inbox, gray bell count | no | no | yes (hide from bell) | auto-archive after 8 wks (UI) |
| warning | inbox, amber count, dashboard "Needs attention" | yes, unless kind muted | no | per kind | until resolved (level) or archived (edge) |
| critical | inbox, red count, pinned on dashboard | always | yes, stays until dismissed | no | until resolved (level) or acknowledged (edge) |
| blocking | a `PendingDecision` with `blocking: true`; Advance disabled | always | yes | no | until answered |

**Signals → messages.** Systems emit `AlertSignal`s into the `WeekReport` (or into `ActionEffect`s for action-time alerts, collated immediately with the same rule). §13 owns the taxonomy, the message record and the collation rule run in pipeline step 16. **Thresholds belong to the emitting section** where it already defines one (§7 `ops.alertPlantIdlePct`, `ops.coverageAlertWeeks`; §9 `fleet.pmOverdueWarnPct`, `fleet.shopBacklogWarnWeeks`; §11 `finance.distress.watchWeeks` and the covenant `watch` status; §10's 5% big-move warning); §13's `game.alerts.*` keys cover only the rest (dedupe, retention, the obligation ladder, morale, and the reorganization case's alert windows, which §11 does not set).

```ts
type Severity = 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'blocking';
interface AlertSignal {
  kind: AlertKind;                         // e.g. 'obligation.dueSoon'
  severity: Exclude<Severity, 'blocking'>;
  trigger: 'level' | 'edge';               // level: re-emitted every week the condition holds; edge: a one-off happening
  dedupeKey: string;                       // e.g. 'obligation.dueSoon:obl_000031'
  subject: EntityRef[];
  templateKey: string; params: Record<string, string | number>;
  dueTurn?: number; explain?: ExplainRef; action?: SuggestedAction;   // primary button target
}
interface InboxMessage {                   // in GameState (state.inbox); read/archived/snoozed flags live in UiPersisted
  id: MsgId; kind: AlertKind; severity: Severity; status: 'open' | 'resolved' | 'answered' | 'defaulted';
  trigger: 'level' | 'edge'; createdTurn: number; lastTurn: number; resolvedTurn?: number; count: number;
  dedupeKey: string; subject: EntityRef[]; templateKey: string; params: Record<string, string | number>;
  dueTurn?: number; decisionId?: DecId;
}
interface PendingDecision {                // §2 owns the record; §13 needs these fields
  id: DecId; kind: string; ownerSection: number; blocking: boolean;
  createdTurn: number; deadlineTurn: number;
  options: { id: string; labelKey: string; action: Action; consequenceKey: string }[];
  defaultOptionId?: string;                // required when blocking == false
  context: { templateKey: string; params: Record<string, string | number>; subject: EntityRef[] };
}
```

**Collation (step 16, deterministic; D-13.33).**
```
signals: group obligation alerts (D-13.46): signals of kind obligation.dueSoon or obligation.missed whose subject obligations share
         (Obligation.category, Obligation.dueTurn) merge into one signal with dedupeKey = kind:category:dueTurn,
         severity = max of the members, subject = members sorted by ID, params.count = n, params.totalUsd = Σ amount
signals: sort by (severityRank desc, kind asc, dedupeKey asc); collapse identical dedupeKeys within the turn (keep the highest severity)
stopCandidates = []
for s in signals:
  if s.trigger = 'level':
    m = open message with m.dedupeKey = s.dedupeKey
        ?? resolved message with that key and turn − m.resolvedTurn ≤ game.alerts.dedupeWindowWeeks (4)   // reopen, no new ID
    if m: prev = m.severity (or 'none' if it was resolved); m.status = 'open'; m.severity = s.severity
          m.count += 1; m.lastTurn = turn; m.params = s.params; m.dueTurn = s.dueTurn
          if rank(s.severity) > rank(prev) and s.severity ≥ warning: stopCandidates += m      // rises stop; steady or falling do not
    else: create m with the next msg_ id; if s.severity ≥ warning: stopCandidates += m
  else (edge): create a new message with the next msg_ id (edges never merge across turns, so a second failure always stops)
               if s.severity ≥ warning: stopCandidates += m
for open level messages not re-emitted this turn: status = 'resolved', resolvedTurn = turn
stopCandidates += PendingDecisions created this turn with blocking
drop messages with status ≠ 'open', no open decision, and lastTurn < turn − game.alerts.inboxRetentionWeeks (104)
```

**Default taxonomy** (owners emit; severity rules use the owner's thresholds where named).

| Kind | Severity rule | Trigger | Owner |

| `cash.projectedNegative` | warning if §11 `forecast13Week` P50 ending cash < 0 in any week ≤ §11 `finance.distress.watchWeeks` (4 on standard; 6 / 4 / 3 by difficulty in §1 1.11; plus §8 `alertBonusWeeks` for a bookkeeper or controller) or P10 < 0 in any week ≤ 2 (= §11 distress stage 0); critical if P50 < 0 in week 1; info if only P10 < 0 within 13 weeks. P1–P3: the single series, which includes the P50 production line, serves as P10 and P50 (D-13.47, D-13.48) | level | §11 |
| `payroll.missed`, `loan.paymentMissed`, `vendor.stopSupply`, `insurance.lapsed` | critical | edge | §11 |

Consequence text: `No plan by Wk 37 converts the case to liquidation` | level | §11 (P4) |
